_note: Job A batch 5. Past-due claims due 2025-12-31 to 2026-03-31. Two corpus checks: the December 2025 year-map video exists (7 December), and the channel's upload record covers the weekly-services claim.

evidence.summary: US equities fell in mid-November 2025 on artificial-intelligence valuation concerns, then recovered into December, ending the year up 17.9 percent and near record levels, with the next record set on 27 January 2026. Crypto moved the other way: bitcoin fell 36 percent from its 6 October record to 80,255 dollars on 21 November.
evidence.rationale: November and December did end higher and the market went on to a record within a month, so the direction is right. It was not a rocket in the two months named: November's largest move was down, and the recovery only got back to where the year already was. A rising market described as taking off is also the lowest-information call available in a year that was already up double digits when he said it on 13 July.

evidence.summary: The Times Square New Year's Eve celebration passed without incident on 31 December 2025 into 1 January 2026, as did New Year gatherings elsewhere in the United States.
evidence.rationale: He withdraws the claim in the act of making it: he asks whether it is coming on 31 December, then says he is not saying that, that he sees in part and hears in part, and turns it into prayer. There is nothing left to fail. The 31 December telling is a news report read aloud, which the extractor marked as such. Recorded as unfalsifiable, and the self-qualification is worth keeping on the record because it is rarer in this corpus than the confident form.

evidence.summary: No major escalation to war involving Russia occurred during 2025. The Ukraine war continued at broadly similar intensity and the year ended with a US-brokered peace framework under negotiation rather than a widening of the conflict.
evidence.rationale: A named country, a named year and a named escalation, and the year closed with movement toward a settlement instead. He says in the same breath that he is praying against it, which is the standard structure here and is recorded as a conditionality field rather than accepted as the reason nothing happened.

evidence.summary: The largest military escalation around Christmas 2025 was American: a CIA strike on a Venezuelan port facility on 31 December, a blockade of sanctioned Venezuelan oil tankers, and authorisation of covert operations inside Venezuela, leading to Maduro's capture in January 2026. No escalation occurred in Ukraine or the Middle East over the Christmas period; Gaza was under the October ceasefire.
evidence.rationale: A real escalation did arrive in the Christmas window and he named it on 14 October, ten weeks ahead. What holds it down is that the claim has no subject: a great escalation of war, with no theatre, no party and no scale, is satisfied by any of the four or five active conflicts moving in either direction. The white Christmas image is left uninterpreted, and the escalation that came was in the one place he never mentions.

evidence.summary: The corpus contains a 7 December 2025 upload titled as a prophetic word for 2026 covering what he has been told so far, which is the year-map video the claim describes. Further December 2025 uploads on the 6th, 10th and 20th carry forward-looking material for 2026.
evidence.rationale: The archive confirms the practice: the December video exists and does what he says it does. That is a real check and it passes. It cannot go higher because the claim is entirely within his own control, which is the opposite of a prediction. Describing a habit you intend to keep is not a forecast, and the added phrase about this year's being his most shaking word yet has no measure.

evidence.summary: US provisional natality data show births roughly flat in 2025 against 2024, near the lowest general fertility rate on record. No change in miscarriage rates is recorded. The claim is addressed to individual viewers.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged all three tellings before the fact as unfalsifiable at corpus level: births among an unnamed audience, and a private outcome for one viewer. A single birth in the audience confirms it, and the national data cannot refute a claim that was never about the nation. The one clause that would have been checkable, generational curses of miscarriage broken, has no measurable referent.

evidence.summary: No drone attack occurred on a European Christmas market, tree-lighting ceremony, parade or New Year crowd in the 2025-26 season. Europe did experience a sustained wave of unattributed drone incursions over airports and military sites from September 2025 into 2026, including repeated closures at Leipzig, prompting large counter-drone procurement.
evidence.rationale: The specific scenario, consumer drones bought online and fitted with charges, flown into holiday crowds, did not happen in the window. The generic threat was already in the news when he described it, since the European drone panic had been running for two months. He then re-points it twice, at stadiums in March and at smuggled Iranian military drones in July, which are different claims with later windows and are not scored here.

evidence.summary: Zohran Mamdani was sworn in as mayor of New York shortly after midnight on 1 January 2026 at the disused City Hall subway station, an event announced in advance and widely covered.
evidence.rationale: The extractor marked this correctly as a report of a scheduled event: he reads a news item aloud on 31 December about a ceremony arranged for the following night. There is no claim of his to score. Recorded so it stops occupying the unchecked queue, and the framing about the real power shift happening underground is commentary on the item, not a prediction.

evidence.summary: New Year's Eve 2025-26 and the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans passed without incident, on the first anniversary of the 1 January 2025 Bourbon Street attack. About 350 Louisiana National Guard troops were deployed alongside more than 800 total security personnel, hotels were at 93 percent capacity and the game was sold out.
evidence.rationale: He named the city, the event and the date, moved the target from New Year's Eve onto the football itself, and nothing happened. The base rate cuts hard the other way here and should be stated: he was naming the single most heavily guarded location in the country that week, on the anniversary of an attack, with a National Guard deployment announced in advance. An incident there was less likely than average, not more.

evidence.summary: Negotiators reached a bipartisan agreement on 29 January 2026 and the Senate passed five of the six remaining appropriations bills on 30 January by 71 to 29, with a short continuing resolution for Homeland Security. The House did not vote in time and a four-day shutdown ran from 31 January to 3 February 2026, the first of two 2026 shutdowns arising from the immigration-enforcement dispute after the killing of Alex Pretti.
evidence.rationale: He said on 12 November that the January budget would be fixed soon and quickly, and most of it was: five of six bills passed inside January on a bipartisan vote. He also said it was already done and simply unannounced, which is the strongest form of the claim and is the part that failed, because the deal broke down over Homeland Security and the government shut down anyway. Quickly is right, already done is not. The black swan and paid demonstrators elements in the same telling are scored under black-swan-event.

evidence.summary: US existing home sales rose 4.8 percent in November 2025 to an annual rate of 4.15 million, the highest since March and up 6.1 percent year on year, the largest annual gain since June 2021, while median prices eased. No federal tax cut was enacted or announced in January 2026; tax provisions from the July 2025 act were already in force.
evidence.rationale: The November half landed and was specific enough to fail: he said in August that he saw November with the housing market going up, and November produced the strongest existing-home sales month since March and the biggest year-on-year gain in four and a half years. The January half did not: no tax cut was announced. Held at partial for that, and because a housing recovery on falling mortgage rates was the widely published expectation for late 2025 when he spoke.

evidence.summary: Jerome Powell remained Federal Reserve chair through January 2026. His term as chair ended in May 2026, after which the Board named him chair pro tempore; Kevin Warsh was confirmed by the Senate on 13 May 2026 by 54 to 45 and sworn in on 22 May 2026. Trump had nominated Warsh in January 2026.
evidence.rationale: The stated month was January and Powell was still chair in January, in February, in March and in April. The handover happened in May, on the schedule the published term end had always specified, which means the outcome was fixed by statute rather than foreseen. He marks the whole thing as his own opinion, which is honest and is recorded. His May 2026 telling then describes the transition correctly, but that is reporting it as it happens, not the January call.

evidence.summary: The corpus shows a 4 December 2025 upload matching the service named, and 19 uploads across January 2026, of which several are prayer streams. No separately identifiable weekly service format is distinguishable in the upload record from the channel's existing near-daily output.
evidence.rationale: This is a statement of intent about his own schedule, not a claim about the world, and the archive cannot settle it because the channel already uploads most days, so a weekly service is not distinguishable from the baseline. The 4 December date checks out. Recorded as unfalsifiable rather than credited or faulted.

evidence.summary: Leo XIV issued a letter for the 25th Winter Olympic Games dated 6 February 2026 and appealed at the Angelus for observance of the Olympic Truce as the Milano Cortina Games opened. The Games ran 6 to 22 February 2026; he had given the start date as 3 February.
evidence.rationale: Something involving the pope and the Olympics did occur inside the three-month window, and he said watch the pope concerning the Olympics three months ahead. Almost all of the credit goes back on the base rate: popes issue messages for every Olympic Games, and an appeal for the Olympic Truce is a fixed feature of the office. He also gets the start date wrong by three days, which matters because the window's end was pinned to it.

evidence.summary: On 20 February 2026 the Supreme Court ruled 6-3 in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump that tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act exceeded presidential authority, with Chief Justice Roberts writing for the majority. Three justices dissented. Litigation against administration measures continued through 2025 and 2026 across many federal courts.
evidence.rationale: Judicial obstruction of administration priorities is the story he described and it is real and sustained; the single largest instance landed in February 2026, which is the month he pointed at on 12 December when he tied three judges to the number three and to 3 February. But the number goes the wrong way: the three judges in the biggest case were the dissenters, the ones siding with the administration, and the ruling came on the 20th rather than the 3rd. The base rate is also very high: hundreds of injunctions against federal action were issued across 2025, so predicting judges obstructing was predicting the daily news.

evidence.summary: On 28 February 2026, six days after the Winter Olympics closed and four days after the State of the Union, Israel and the United States launched strikes on Iran that killed the supreme leader and many officials; Iran retaliated with ballistic missiles against Israel and Gulf states and closed the Strait of Hormuz. The S&P 500 fell about 8 percent between 27 February and 30 March 2026, its worst month since 2022.
evidence.rationale: He put a black swan around the Olympic window on 13 January and the largest unforeseen shock of the year arrived within days of the closing ceremony. That is close enough to be worth recording seriously. Two things stop it going further. Black swan names no event, no domain and no direction, so it is satisfied by any surprise; the phrase is also standard market commentary, published in dozens of 2026 outlooks before he used it. And the June 2025 telling attached to this claim, that Israel struck Iran against American preference, describes something that had already happened when he said it.

evidence.summary: The Milano Cortina opening and closing ceremonies were held on 6 and 22 February 2026 and Super Bowl LX on 8 February 2026. No occult content was identified by organisers or reported by mainstream coverage.
evidence.rationale: The extractor recorded it exactly: this is a reading rather than an event. Symbolism claims about ceremonies cannot be refuted, because any imagery can be read either way and no observation settles it. Recorded so it leaves the queue.

evidence.summary: The published congressional calendar had the House out of session until 23 February 2026, which is the fact read aloud on air.
evidence.rationale: A published schedule read from a screen. There is no claim here of any kind, and the extractor said so. Recorded to close it.

evidence.summary: Trump delivered the 2026 State of the Union in the House chamber on 24 February 2026, the longest joint address in modern times at one hour 47 minutes. Speaker Johnson had issued the invitation naming that date and Trump accepted it on 7 January 2026. Four days later, on 28 February, the United States and Israel struck Iran.
evidence.rationale: The date carried the year's set-piece political speech and sat four days before the year's largest geopolitical rupture, so as a pointer it landed. The base rate destroys most of the value: the State of the Union date had been publicly announced and accepted on 7 January, six days before he named it on the 13th. A date already fixed for the president's agenda-setting address is by definition the day that sets the tone, and he attaches no content to it beyond that.

evidence.summary: The Milano Cortina Games ran 6 to 22 February 2026. Hooded protesters clashed with police near the Santagiulia arena after the opening ceremony, with water cannon, tear gas and about five arrests; Italian authorities also mitigated Russian-linked cyberattacks on Games-related sites. No attack occurred at the Games and nothing involving super yachts occurred in January 2026.
evidence.rationale: Watch the Olympics was said on 6 October, four months ahead, and the Games did produce disorder and a foiled cyber campaign. That is thin: protest at an Olympics is close to routine, and the instruction carries no content beyond watch. The two concrete details he added, January recurring and super yachts and boats, produced nothing that can be matched. Scored partial for the Olympics half only, and the same events are already scored under olympics-opening-ceremony-watch, so no credit is counted twice.

evidence.summary: US equities continued rising to an all-time high on 27 January 2026, then fell: February closed lower as the technology rally cooled and March returned minus 4.98 percent, the worst month since 2022, leaving the index about 8.7 percent below its January peak. The break coincided with the opening of the Iran war on 28 February 2026.
evidence.rationale: This is the better of his market calls. Said across July 2025: ride the wave, it is transitional, it will not last long, I see it in the winter, it goes into 2026 and then it is over. The run did extend into 2026, peaked in the last week of January, and broke through February and March. Held at partial for two reasons. Ride the wave then it ends is close to unfalsifiable in form, since every run ends and any subsequent decline confirms it. And the break came from an event nobody could have priced, a war beginning on 28 February, rather than from the exhaustion he described.

evidence.summary: The date entered the material from news coverage rather than from a vision, and he says so on air. The Iran war had begun on 28 February 2026, the day before the date named.
evidence.rationale: He states plainly that he does not know when it will come about, that they are saying March 1st and he did not know, and that he does not watch the news because it is brought to him. That is a description of where the date came from, not a claim, and it is the most useful methodological passage in this batch. Recorded as unfalsifiable and flagged for that reason rather than scored.

evidence.summary: A total lunar eclipse occurred on 3 March 2026, visible from the Americas, Asia and Australia, as published years in advance.
evidence.rationale: A scheduled astronomical event, and to his credit he treats it as one: he says it will be fun, that he wants to watch it, and asks how they can see it. No sign is claimed and no meaning attached, so there is nothing to score. Worth keeping beside blood-moon-march-2025-war, where the same phenomenon is given prophetic weight.

evidence.summary: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck the Tyrrhenian Sea about 40 km southwest of Naples just after midnight on 10 March 2026, at a depth of 373 km within the subducting African plate, which specialists said was unlikely to be related to Campi Flegrei or Vesuvius. No eruption occurred, no tsunami was generated and the Naples coastline was not flooded.
evidence.rationale: A large, dated earthquake near Naples did happen and he had been describing quake swarms as the sign before an eruption there. The mechanism he named is wrong on the seismology: the 10 March event was a deep slab earthquake 373 km down, which is not a precursor to shallow volcanism, and Italian specialists said so at the time. The eruption, the tsunami and the flooding all remain absent, as they have since the 2022 word. The claim is now being carried forward on quake counts, most recently 94 in a day in August 2026, which is the same structure as the 2023 Italy claim scored under italy-volcano.

evidence.summary: The 71st Chicago St Patrick's Day Parade ran on Columbus Drive on Saturday 14 March 2026 under the theme Faith, Peace and Unity, with river dyeing that morning and further parades on the South Side and North West Side on the 15th. No incident occurred at any of them.
evidence.rationale: A named city, a named event and a fixed date, which is the most scoreable form a warning takes in this corpus, and nothing happened. Calling it strategic added no content. The parade he named is also one of the most heavily policed civic events in the country, so an incident there was below the general base rate rather than above it.

evidence.summary: No attempt on the president occurred in the period covered by these prayers. No incident involving his safety is recorded between November 2025 and March 2026.
evidence.rationale: The extractor's note on the falsifier is the whole finding and it was written before any outcome: he survives, which is credited to the prayer. Structured this way an attempt confirms the warning and no attempt confirms the intercession, so no observation can bear on it. Kept distinct from candidate-outdoor-attack, which named a setting and a configuration in advance and is scored strongly on that basis.

evidence.summary: They look up a published eclipse path on the NASA website and read off the date and where totality ends. Eclipse paths are computed and published decades ahead.
evidence.rationale: Reading a schedule off a website is not receiving a date, and the extractor said so at the time. There is no claim to score. Recorded to close it out, and useful as a contrast with the several claims in this database where a published astronomical date is presented as a sign.

evidence.summary: The president neither died nor left office in the weeks following the 6 March 2026 telling. He remained in office through the Iran war that began on 28 February 2026 and delivered the State of the Union on 24 February 2026.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged the January telling before the fact: make or break covers both outcomes and the decisions are not specified. The one telling that did set a testable bar, the president dying or going home within a couple of weeks, failed, which is worth recording even though it cannot carry the claim. The April telling then describes the method in his own words, that the separate pieces prayed over since October are assembled afterwards into a picture, and that is the most useful line in the thread.

evidence.summary: Robert Morris, founder of Gateway Church, was indicted in March 2025 on five felony counts of child sexual abuse and pleaded guilty on 3 October 2025 under an agreement carrying a ten-year sentence with six months in county jail. Further cases surfaced in the period, including the October 2025 arrest and 2026 sentencing of the son of an Indiana megachurch pastor on child exploitation charges. No comparable wave crossed into Catholic or mainline denominations in the window.
evidence.rationale: Eleven tellings across nearly two years, and cases did surface. The June 2024 telling is genuinely prior to the Morris indictment. Two things hold it at partial. The base rate for this category is close to certainty: exposures of church leaders over sexual and financial misconduct occur continuously and have their own long-running investigative beat, so a wave is always in progress. And the specific extension he made, that it would reach all denominations including Catholics and not only large charismatic platforms, is the part that would have carried information, and the 2025-26 cases were concentrated in exactly the large evangelical and charismatic platforms he said it would go beyond.
